provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^321 - 1 with a(x) = x^1 + x^73 + x^91 + x^160 + x^173 + x^201 + x^229 + x^231 + x^233 + x^260 + x^277 + x^281 + x^299 + x^311, b(x) = x^27 + x^64 + x^96 + x^166 + x^192 + x^211 + x^252 + x^259; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
